app_info.subtitle: Memory layer for AI agents and apps
app_info.description: RushDB is a memory layer for AI agents and apps. Push any JSON and get graph relationships and semantic search automatically — no schema, no pipeline, no glue code. Through ChatGPT, users can inspect the auto-detected graph schema, search records by graph traversal or semantic similarity, create and update structured records, manage relationships, export data, and configure managed embedding indexes for vector search.

test_cases.description: Discover the project graph schema before answering a data question.
test_cases.user_prompt: What kinds of records and relationships are available in my RushDB project?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the project labels, property metadata, and relationship directions in a concise schema summary.

test_cases.user_prompt: Find the open tasks created this month and group them by owner.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns matching records or aggregate rows using valid labels, fields, and query syntax.

test_cases.user_prompt: Remember that we chose Clerk for authentication on May 20, 2026.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates a structured record with an appropriate label and confirms the new record ID.

test_cases.description: Preview and update an existing record.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find the record about Clerk authentication and update its status to approved.
test_cases.expected_output: Finds the relevant record, applies a partial update, and confirms the update without removing other fields.

test_cases.description: Create a relationship between resolved records.
test_cases.user_prompt: Connect the Clerk authentication decision to the web app project record.
test_cases.expected_output: Resolves the source and target records, creates the relationship, and reports that it was attached.

test_cases.user_prompt: Export my customer records from California as CSV.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns CSV content for records matching the requested label and filter.

test_cases.user_prompt: Create a semantic index for Note.content, then find notes similar to our pricing discussion.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates or checks the semantic index, reports index readiness, and returns semantically similar records when searchable.

test_cases.user_prompt: Delete all test import records from last week.
test_cases.expected_output: Previews the matching records, asks for explicit confirmation, and deletes only after confirmation.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated calendar scheduling.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Schedule a meeting with Ana tomorrow at 2 PM.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it cannot create or manage calendar events.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for public web search.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Search the web for the latest database benchmark results.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it only works with RushDB project data.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for payment or credential handling.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Store my credit card number and login password for later.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not collect or store sensitive payment credentials or passwords.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger destructive actions without confirmation.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Actually never mind, do not delete anything from RushDB.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should avoid delete tools and answer that no deletion was performed.
